title: Invoice Management UX: Clear Old Data button and Ageing Days sorting

requirements.summary: Relabel the admin-only destructive reset action as a clear "Clear Old Data" button while keeping the confirmation dialog and existing mutation/toast behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Invoice Management page (frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPage.tsx), the admin-only destructive action is clearly labeled as "Clear Old Data" (user-facing text).
The confirmation dialog remains required before the reset is executed.
The reset still calls the existing React Query mutation hook (useClearAllData) and shows success/failure toasts as it does today.
Non-admin users do not see the "Clear Old Data" control.

file_operations.description: Update user-facing labels for the existing destructive action: change the button text to "Clear Old Data" and adjust the confirmation dialog action text accordingly, while preserving the existing AlertDialog confirmation flow, useClearAllData mutation usage, and toast success/failure handling. Keep the control admin-only by continuing to rely on the role gating provided by the selected "authorization" component via useCurrentUser().isAdmin (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Add an Ageing Days column computed client-side from Invoice Date and provide a visible toggle to sort invoices by ageing (oldest/newest first) with safe fallbacks for invalid dates.
acceptanceCriteria: The invoices table (frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesTable.tsx) includes a new column labeled "Ageing Days" that displays an integer day count for each invoice based on Invoice Date -> today.

A sort control is available for Ageing Days (e.g., a button or clickable column header) that toggles sort order between oldest-first and newest-first, and the current sort direction is visible in the UI.
Sorting by Ageing Days reorders the displayed invoices accordingly (and works together with existing Search & Filter behavior on the Invoice Management page).
If an invoice date cannot be parsed into a valid date, the Ageing Days cell shows a safe fallback (e.g., "—"), and sorting places these rows consistently (e.g., at the bottom) without runtime errors.
No backend schema or storage changes are required for Ageing Days; it is computed client-side from the existing invoiceDate text field.

file_operations.description: Create client-side helpers to (1) safely parse the existing invoiceDate string into a Date when possible and (2) compute an integer Ageing Days value as the day difference from invoice date to today, returning a null/undefined-friendly result for invalid/unparseable dates so the UI can render a fallback and sort consistently.

Add an "Ageing Days" column that displays the computed day count (or a safe fallback like "—" when not computable) using the new ageingDays utility; add a visible sort toggle control in the Ageing Days column header to switch between oldest-first and newest-first; apply sorting before pagination and ensure invalid-date rows are placed consistently (e.g., always at the bottom) without runtime errors. Ensure the sort works on the already filtered invoices list provided by the Invoice Management page.
